$comment: Sail motion preset vocabulary — a CLOSED, design-system-owned set of spring + tween configs. The compiler resolves a `motion: { scale: 'sm' }` reference against this file at build time. Adding a preset = adding a row here + (optionally) extending the sx token surface. Mirrors the `sail-sx` rule's design: token-only, no raw values, no bracket escape.

spring:snappy.$doc: high-stiffness, well-damped — quick UI feedback (button press, toggle)

spring:gentle.$doc: softer settling — hover state, panel expand

spring:bouncy.$doc: visible overshoot — playful micro-interaction, badge pop

spring:deliberate.$doc: slow, weighty — page transitions, drawer slide

press.$doc: scale-down on pointerdown — paired with a spring:snappy release

release.$doc: scale-up on pointerup — completes the press/release pair

pulse.$doc: gentle scale pulse, infinite — loading state, attention

bounce.$doc: translateY 0→-100% + opacity 0.4→1 — a 7-12px dot's visible bounce, paired per dot, with a 150ms stagger step that lands as a per-dot phase offset (dot 1: 0ms, dot 2: 150ms, dot 3: 300ms). Deliberate (420ms/phase) so the loop reads as a calm breathing rhythm, not a frantic flicker.

marquee.$doc: translateX 0→-50% — the <sail-band> one-direction infinite loop. The runtime derives the duration from measured content width (px/s), so the rate holds for any content. Use `marquee-reverse` to flip direction.

marquee-reverse.$doc: translateX 0→+50% — the <sail-band direction="reverse"> one-direction loop. Same px/s derivation as `marquee`.

spin.$doc: rotate 0deg→360deg, one direction, infinite — a slow-spinning logo/mark. NOT alternate: a spin goes one way, it does not ping-pong. Distinct from the spinner ring's fixed 0.7s spin, which is a component-owned CSS animation, not this preset.

fill.$doc: 0→1 progress fill, infinite alternate — pair with the `scale-x` property (origin-left) for a bar/track that fills then empties, or `scale-y` (origin-bottom) for a column. A single-axis reveal, distinct from `pulse` (uniform scale).

slip.$doc: translate 0→-12(px on translate-x/y, % is not expressible) then back, infinite alternate — a subtle ambient drift-and-return, e.g. a list row that slides out and back. Pair with `dim` on opacity for a slide+fade.

dim.$doc: opacity 1→0→1, infinite alternate — the ambient-loop companion to the one-shot `fade-out`. Same duration token as `slip` so a slide+fade stays in phase.

drift.$doc: translate 0→24(px) and back, infinite alternate — a slow ambient position drift. Compose with `tilt`+`pop` on the same element to animate x/rotate/scale independently (motion's 'independent transforms').

tilt.$doc: rotate 0deg→15deg and back, infinite alternate — a gentle recurring tilt (distinct from `spin`'s continuous full rotation).

pop.$doc: scale 1→1.75 and back, infinite alternate — a strong recurring pop, larger than `pulse` (1→1.04). Attention/emphasis in an ambient loop.

property_aliases.$doc: Property values for `motion: { scale: 'sm' }` — the agent picks a scale alias, the compiler resolves to (0.96/1.02/1.06/...). Mirrors how `sx="text:sm"` resolves to `var(--text-sm)`.
